accepted.feature: Domus and Mitreo delle Pareti Dipinte
accepted.quote: The complex known as "Domus and Mitreo delle Pareti Dipinte" began its life in the later second century BCE and was remodeled during the time of Augustus. A mithraeum is built in the northwest part of the building in the later second century CE. Representative point: longitude 12.286498, latitude 41.753338.
accepted.note: Begun in the later second century BCE and remodeled under Augustus; a mithraeum was added in the later second century CE.
